color.note: One dark theme built on the Nord palette (Polar Night surfaces, Snow Storm text, Frost accents, Aurora signals). Surfaces step lighter as they come forward: page → raised → hover → strong.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Nord0. Page background, card bodies, grid bodies, list bodies. Fields placed on a raised surface (dialogs, card headers, popups, settings panels) use this as their fill.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Nord1. Card headers, tab chips, popups, menus, dialogs, slide-out panels, the left page navigator, and the fill of every field that sits directly on surface-page.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Nord2. Hover fill for rows, list items, icon buttons and inactive tabs; the active tab chip; card outlines (1px) and popup borders.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Nord3. Hover fill for secondary buttons and for controls already sitting on surface-hover; disabled button fill. Never a text colour (1.7:1 on surface-page).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines: under grid headers, under the page tab row, between toolbar rows, under popup headers. 1px only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Nord6. Headings, card titles, dialog titles, and text on surface-hover / surface-strong. 10.8:1 on surface-page, 6.4:1 on surface-strong.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Nord5. Field values and grid cell text on surface-page and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Nord4. Body copy, inactive tab labels, list item text, menu items. 9.3:1 on surface-page, 7.5:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and disabled button labels on surface-page and surface-raised (5.5:1 / 4.5:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Floating field labels, placeholders, captions, empty-state text. Kept from the source: 4.46:1 on surface-page and 3.6:1 on surface-raised, below 4.5:1 — use only for labels and hints, never for content a user must read to act.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Nord8. The one primary accent: primary button fill, selected tab label and underline, active/selected states, focus underline on fields, links that act. 6.2:1 on surface-page, 5.0:1 on surface-raised; on surface-hover (active tab) 4.3:1, so active tab labels are set bold.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Nord7. Hover fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills (6.2:1 / 6.0:1). Never white on accent.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Nord9. Resting colour of every icon and icon button, dropdown chevrons, column filter icons, floating-label accents. 4.6:1 on surface-page, 3.7:1 on surface-raised. Icons turn accent on hover.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Nord10. Only for large atmospheric glows (sign-in page radial light at 22% alpha). Not for text or controls.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Nord11. Destructive hover fill (as danger-tint) and its icon colour; error markers. As text it fails (3.0:1) — use danger-text for words.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error and destructive message text on danger-tint and surface-page (5.9:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Nord13. Warning text and icon on warning-tint; environment warnings.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Nord14. Success state, positive values, attached-file names. Pair with an icon or word; never told apart from danger by hue alone.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected / toggled-on fill behind an icon button or row (e.g. an active filter toggle), always with accent foreground.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info alert background, with accent text.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning alert background, with warning text.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Hover fill of destructive icon buttons (delete, remove file); error alert background at 16%.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Read-only / disabled field fill on surface-page so the field never vanishes; label and value stay legible.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Soft 1px ring around a focused field, paired with a 2px accent underline. No other focus outlines are drawn.

type.note: Inter everywhere. Enable font-feature-settings "cv05" (lower-case l with tail), "cv08" (upper-case I with serifs) and "ss03" (round quotes) for legibility; add "tnum" in grids and numeric fields.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: App/page name in the page header (Projects, Home).

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Column group headings inside a card (Project Information).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: field values, list items, tabs, buttons.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Primary button labels, the active tab label.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary buttons in tight spaces (Clear Filters), grid cells in dense grids, menu captions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Floating field label resting above a value; environment tags.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Floating label in compact 40px controls inside popups; hint text.

spacing.note: A 2px-based scale. Rhythm inside forms is space-3 between every field; popups pad space-2.5/space-3; dialogs pad 18px/20px.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a list option and its neighbour.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between adjacent hover boxes (spinner arrows), list inset.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs, checkbox to checkbox, inset of an icon button inside a field, gap above/below a toolbar divider.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its neighbour button (field + filter button), popup list right padding clear of the scrollbar, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Field inner left padding (labels and values start here), popup padding, card right inset from the scrollbar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between fields, empty-state text inset, gap below a card header, inset from window edges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card body padding, gap between card columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog horizontal padding, navigator padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sign-in card padding, large section gaps.

radius.note: Everything that can be hovered, filled or focused is rounded. Adjacent elements share one radius.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tiny 20px controls (breadcrumb chevron button).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fields, buttons, icon buttons, hover boxes, list options, tab chips, alerts, filter boxes, menu items, search inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popups, menus, dialogs, panels, the page navigator, grids and previews.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The sign-in card only.

size.note: Control sizes. Hover boxes are explicit squares so neighbours never overlap.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Field height (floating-label fields), search bars, the filter button beside a search bar.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Popup dropdowns, popup toggle buttons, delete buttons in filter popups, primary/secondary buttons in dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar icon buttons, overflow (⋮) buttons, compact buttons (Filter, Clear Filters).

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Grid filter-row boxes and their buttons, spinner arrows, chevron hover boxes, column-header filter icons.

tokens.name: hit-icon
tokens.usage: Icon actions inside a field (lookup/search icon) and popup header icons.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Minimum width of left slide-out panels.

tokens.name: panel-ext-w
tokens.usage: Extra width added when a slide-out opens a second column.

tokens.name: shadow-card-lift
tokens.usage: Sign-in card and floating dialogs only. Everything else is separated by surface steps and 1px outlines, not shadows.
